metadata.scenario: A customer calls to report that the cleaning service they received left streaks on their windows and was unsatisfactory. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Patricia Wilson, and I was referred by Dr. Anderson. I’m calling about my mother who needs post-surgery care after her hip replacement. Nice to meet you, Patricia. I can help with that. When is your mother’s surgery scheduled? It’s on October 15th, and we’re looking for care starting the day after. Okay, we can schedule post-surgery recovery care for her. That service is priced between $85 and $110 per visit. That sounds good, but I have a bit of a complaint about a service we had before. I’m sorry to hear that. What seems to be the issue? The cleaning service we received last week left streaks on the windows. It was quite unsatisfactory. I apologize for the inconvenience, Patricia. We strive for quality, and that’s not our standard. I appreciate that, but I really expected better, especially with the cost. I completely understand. I’d like to make it right. Would you like me to arrange a follow-up visit? Yes, please. But I also want to ensure that the team understands how to do a proper job this time. Absolutely. I’ll ensure that the team is briefed on your concerns. When would you like the follow-up visit? As soon as possible, perhaps this Saturday? Let me check the schedule… Yes, we have availability this Saturday. I’ll book it for you. Great, thank you. I really hope this gets resolved. I will also provide you with my direct number, so you can reach out if you have any further issues. That would be very helpful, thanks. My direct number is +13165559201. Feel free to call me anytime. I will, thank you. And about my mother’s care, can we finalize that as well? Yes, I’ll schedule the post-surgery care starting on October 16th for 1-3 hours daily. Okay, that works. Can we also discuss medication management for her? Certainly! Medication management is priced between $65 and $80 per visit as well. Yes, let’s include that too, please. I’ll set that up for you. We can arrange the medication management alongside her post-surgery visits. Perfect, thank you so much for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Patricia! I’ll send a confirmation email with all the details shortly. Thank you, I appreciate your assistance today. Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day!
